summary: Coordinator context-access incident: an unfiltered current review manifest was printed instead of selected fields. No repair authorization was prepared.

incident.operation: Parsed and printed the whole review JSON, including its exhaustive artifact list; tool output was truncated. A subsequent read selected only outcome/findings.
incident.violated_boundary: Private evidence must be read through exact authorized locators or selected JSON fields; whole manifests must not be printed.

missing_decision.required_action: Assess the context-access incident and dispatch a fresh bounded coordinator session for current F01. Supply selected review findings and selected delivery fields, without manifest dumps.
